case_011: angular_precise + deep_jewel + transparent_glaze: face built from hard-edged straight-sided facets and a razor-straight lapel; jacket carries deep emerald-green plus aubergine/navy panels (jewel hue at deep value, not grey); translucent mauve/tan washes over neck and cheek let the base skin tone read through.
case_041: bold_outer_sparse_inner + airy_pastel + crisp_shape_shadow: continuous darker shoulder/collar silhouette line against an almost bare interior (only faint sparse fold hints); pale pink/mint/lilac washes on white shirt; neck and shoulder shadows are hard-edged shapes with sharp boundaries.
case_071: bold_outer_sparse_inner + limited_two_tone + subtle_contact_shadow: heavy dark line on shoulder, placket and collar edges with a line-free shirt interior; palette restricted to warm cream/tan plus neutral dark, no third hue; darks appear only where forms meet (under jaw, collar-to-neck, placket V).
case_101: broken_dry + muted_split_complement + broad_blended_plane: cuff, sleeve-underside and hand contours are visibly interrupted dry segments rather than continuous line; slate-teal top against olive/khaki skirt and warm skin at low saturation; sweater modelled as large diagonal soft-blended value planes.
case_131: crisp_uniform + muted_split_complement + fine_tonal_hatching: even-width crisp contours on lapel, collar, buttons and cuff; fine parallel hatch strokes across the shirt and in the neck/jaw shadow; muted slate blue against warm tan skin and greige ground.
case_161: elastic_pressure + airy_pastel + transparent_glaze: jaw/neck and collar lines visibly swell then taper (thick under the chin, thinning to the ear); mint/peach/lilac/butter pastels across all three seeds; overlapping translucent colour layers on face and shirt with the underlayer showing through.
case_191: fine_tapered + cool_nocturne + crisp_shape_shadow: hair-fine tapering contours on hands, cuff and neckline; deep indigo/violet/teal-green night palette held at saturation; sweater shadows are discrete hard-edged indigo shapes rather than blends.
case_221: fine_tapered + warm_earth + soft_two_band: delicate thinning outlines on sleeve and hands; olive-khaki top over rust-brown skirt on warm greige; shading resolves to one light band plus one soft-edged shadow band on sleeve and skirt, no third tone.
case_251: rounded_soft + limited_two_tone + subtle_contact_shadow: soft, slightly diffuse rounded lines with no sharp terminals on cuffs, placket and hands; palette restricted to charcoal/warm-grey garment plus greige ground; darkest values confined to contact points (under cuffs, between hands, waist seam).
case_281: selective_edge + muted_split_complement + transparent_glaze: edge line present on arm, cuff and hands but dissolving entirely where skirt and right sleeve meet the ground; dusty blue with olive/sage and muted lilac at low saturation; garment shading is overlapping see-through washes.
